source_refs.note: 2- Chromatin Fibre: a main subheading of 19.1.2 Chemical Composition and Organization of Chromosome, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 118-118.

blocks.text: In the early stages of cell division, the nucleosome string again coils about its axis. Tightly packed (condensed) nucleosomes make a thicker fibre called chromatin fibre (30 nm).

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: There are two regions in chromatin. The inactive portions of chromatin produce dark bands and are called heterochromatin. Whereas active portions of chromosomes are called euchromatin.
